_comment: invent.c learn_unseen_invent(): wands are created with dknown clear (mkobj.c clear_dknown()), so when the blindfold comes off they are observed in inventory order, before any sort runs. This game is the same on every host; it is a control for the other sortloot-order-* recipes. A blindfolded Samurai wishes for three wands, takes the blindfold off, lists her inventory (invent.c display_pickinv(), nine objects) and pages through her discoveries.
